youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

Prayer for the wait nobody claps for.

He: Jesus... the visa got rejected again. ✈️
He: Second time this year. I can't tell if I'm waiting on a door or just banging on a wall.
Jesus: A closed door isn't My last word. And waiting on Me isn't standing still. It's being rebuilt while you wait.
He: Rebuilt? I'm tired. Every form, every fee, every 'we regret to inform you'.
Jesus: Eagles don't beat their wings harder into the storm. They wait for the wind and rise on it. Your strength was never meant to come from trying again alone.
Jesus: Maybe the wait isn't the delay of your life. Maybe it's where your strength is being rebuilt.
What are you still waiting on that nobody knows about?

“But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; and they shall walk, and not faint.”
Isaiah 40:31 (KJV)

Eagles wait for the wind, then rise on it.
